published_baseline: Founder-approved Geomacro Commercial V1 website redesign with a concise signal-to-decision buyer journey across desktop and mobile; live Intelligence, separate Risk Indices, Critical Minerals and Rare Earth Risk, Ask Geomacro, institutional workflows, governed API and agent access, and Risk Gate boundaries remain clearly separated from technical-proof surfaces. Homepage remains pricing-free; Free Explorer and the 0.05 USDC x402 first-20,000 successful paid-delivery offer are presented under API and Agents. Customer Care and contact@geomacro.live remain the human support escalation path. The Arc/onchain technical-proof surface remains isolated from the core production website. Operational resilience update: the root error boundary self-heals stale hashed client assets after a publish and the visible retry performs a full document reload. Runtime website hardening update: x402 health probing is bounded; public Intelligence, Event detail, Risk Indices and Ask Geomacro use the verified B2 production serving boundary instead of customer-facing Supabase reads; Risk Indices expose an explicit unavailable state instead of an infinite refreshing skeleton, use fixed user-safe outage copy, and label stale continuity data as last verified without fabricating zero-risk, per-domain counts, deltas or history. Production public-identity update: buyer-facing navigation, footer, wallet copy and commerce status no longer present Testnet API or testnet proof as the product identity; technical proof routes remain available as implementation evidence while public status follows live runtime contracts.
policy: Public website presentation is frozen. Intentional website changes require explicit founder approval and a dedicated baseline update.
